name: Saki wa Mou Nurenure de Asoko ga J*nj*n Shite Gozaimasu.
original_name: サキはもう濡れ濡れでアソコがJ○NJ○Nしてございます。
source:
I, Tachibana Saki, was whisked from my time in the Edo period to modern Japan, where I have become a nurse and work at a hospital. It's a very stressful job, and the best way to cleanse oneself is to have sex. I frequently swallow "penis-illin" from the young doctors and patients, for my own health.

Each night I visit a different patient's bed and have jin jin so I feel less stressed.

An erotic RPG game - control Saki and guide her into 10 hospital rooms.
After she reaches bliss, what will become of her?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079727.html]DLsite[/url]]

我，橘咲，从江户时代穿越到了现代日本，如今成了一名护士，在医院工作。这份工作压力极大，而净化身心的最佳方法就是做爱。为了自己的健康，我经常从年轻医生和患者那里服用“阴茎西林”。
